groupRule: Longest-prefix mapping: amz-service/amz-service-<domain>/ -> <domain>; amz-common/ -> common; amz-gateway/ -> gateway; amz-frontend/ -> frontend; tools/synthetic-data/ -> synthetic-data; k8s/ -> deploy/k8s; docs/ -> docs; all other paths -> review-required.
